versions.changelog:
Initial release of gigma-design-canvas.

- Launches an AI-powered design tool with a real, fully editable canvas and 19 MCP tools.
- Supports creation, editing, arrangement, and export of social media graphics, thumbnails, banners, cards, and batch designs.
- Enables full layer and element control: add, update, mask, reorder, and delete shapes, text, images, and lines.
- Offers high-res PNG export up to 3x scale (up to 5760×3240) and screenshot previews.
- Allows seamless project management, template cloning, and programmatic or conversational design workflows.
- Provides clear setup instructions, workflow examples, error handling tips, and documentation links.
